text: {"lessons":["With no trades so far, short-term account swings alone are not a reason to act; each month I should reassess the portfolio rather than react impulsively.","Past price changes do not predict future changes, so I should not treat recent gains or losses as reliable signals for what comes next.","I should be willing to sell when the reasons for holding a stock no longer make sense, rather than keeping it just to avoid admitting a purchase was a mistake."]}
